methodology.priority_formula: modelled WorldPop population × relative multi-scene heat rank
methodology.coverage: Shortest-path network distance on the Phase 1 filtered pedestrian graph; disconnected components have no path.
methodology.threshold_label: network-distance planning assumption, not proof of a five-minute walk
methodology.snap_rule: closest graph vertex; distances over 100 m fail and are not treated as reachable
methodology.candidate_cost: ₹5 lakh standard planning unit — not a procurement quote
methodology.optimiser: deterministic exact equal-cost maximum modelled-priority coverage; validated primary 400 m equal-coverage ties are preserved, then candidate_id resolves ties
